title: Teodoro dares China to expose alleged ties with PH politicians

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Friday challenged China to disclose the alleged business and financial dealings of Philippine politicians with Beijing, questioning whether the reported threat was intended to destabilize the country. “I-disclose nila. Tapos malalaman natin kung totoo o hindi or talaga nagde-destab na sila dito,” Teodoro said in a virtual interview with reporters. (Let them disclose it. Then we will find out whether the allegations are true or whether they are actually trying to destabilize the country.) The defense chief was asked about a report by the Manila-based Chinese Commercial News that Beijing was considering […]...
